{{Top|leg}}
'''Short bows''' were a type of [[Bow/Legends|bow]]. They were commonly used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhamalai]]. [[Denel Moonrunner]] carved several short bows himself, using them to shoot targets with his friend, [[Nadra Enasteri]].<ref name="Rhamalai">{{JournalCite|13|The Occupation of Rhamalai}}</ref>
